job.title: Customer Service Administrator
job.description:
EQUIP People is seeking a reliable and customer-focused Customer Service Administrator to join our busy Palmerston North client on a fixed term assignment till the beginning of 2027.
 
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with customers, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and has strong administration and data entry skills.
 
What you'll be doing:
  • Processing customer orders and quotes
  • Managing pricing and invoicing
  • Handling customer enquiries via phone and email
  • Coordinating deliveries and schedules
  • Supporting customers with updates and issue resolution
  • General administration and data entry
What we're looking for:
  • Previous customer service or administration experience
  • Strong communication skills
  • Accurate data entry and attention to detail
  • Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities
  • Positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills
  • Experience in manufacturing or building-related industries is helpful but not essential
What's on offer:
  • Fixed-term role covering maternity leave
  • October start
  • Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm
  • Supportive team environment
  • Opportunity to gain experience with a well-established business
If you're organised, customer-focused and available for an immediate start, we'd love to hear from you.
 
How to apply:
If you have the right experience and attributes, then register your interest by sending an updated cover letter with your suitability and relevant experience for the role by selecting the "Apply Now" button.

job.title: Machine Operator - Panel Manufacturing
job.description:
EQUIP People is looking for a reliable Machine Operator to join a busy panel manufacturing operation in Hornby.

You'll be working alongside the production team, operating machinery used in the manufacture of specialist building panels. This is a hands-on position where you'll help keep production moving, monitor machine operation and ensure products are made accurately and to the required standard.
 
The role also involves some basic computer work and entering simple programme information. You don't need advanced computer skills, but you should be comfortable using a computer, following prompts and entering information.
 
Previous machine operating or manufacturing experience would be useful but the right attitude and willingness to learn are just as important.
 
What You'll Be Doing
- Operating machinery within the panel production process
- Working alongside the production and line-feeding team
- Entering basic programme information and machine settings
- Monitoring machine operation and production output
- Checking finished products for quality and accuracy
- Identifying and reporting production issues
- Keeping machinery and the surrounding work area tidy
- Following operating instructions and health and safety procedures

What We're Looking For
- Previous machine operating or manufacturing experience advantageous
- Comfortable using basic computer systems
- Able to follow instructions and work with simple programmes
- Good attention to detail
- Reliable, punctual and motivated
- Practical approach to problem-solving
- Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment
- Reliable transport to Hornby
 
What's on Offer
- $24/hr starting rate
- Monday-Friday, day shift
- Immediate start available
- Temp-to-permanent opportunity
- Weekly pay
- Opportunity to develop machine operating skills
 
Apply Now
If you're practical, reliable and interested in developing your machine operating experience, we'd like to hear from you.
 
Contact EQUIP People: 028 2552 0166
Email your CV to: apply@equippeople.co.nz
 
Applicants must have the legal right to work in New Zealand.

You don't need extensive manufacturing experience but reliability, a good attitude and a willingness to learn are essential.

job.title: Forklift Operator - Production / Line Feeding
job.description:
EQUIP People is looking for an experienced Forklift Operator to support production operations at a busy manufacturing site in Hornby.
 
This isn't a traditional warehouse forklift role. You'll be responsible for moving materials and feeding the production line to ensure the manufacturing process keeps running efficiently.
 
You'll be working around production machinery and in an environment where dust and respiratory protection requirements may apply. A respiratory mask is required for certain tasks and you'll need to be comfortable following the relevant workplace safety procedures.
 
What You'll Be Doing
- Operating a forklift to move materials around the production area
- Feeding materials into production lines as required
- Loading and unloading materials
- Keeping production supplied and running efficiently
- Working around manufacturing machinery and equipment
- Following site safety procedures
- Wearing appropriate PPE and respiratory protection when required
- Completing basic equipment checks
- Maintaining a safe and tidy work area
 
What We're Looking For
- Current OSH forklift certificate - essential
- Previous forklift experience
- Manufacturing or production environment experience advantageous
- Comfortable working in a production environment
- Able to follow safety procedures and instructions
- Comfortable wearing respiratory protection when required
- Reliable, punctual and safety-conscious
- Good communication and teamwork
- Able to pass pre-employment drug testing
- Reliable transport to Hornby
 
What's on Offer
- $24/hr + $1 allowance
- Monday-Friday, 6:00am-2:00pm
- Temp-to-permanent opportunity
- Weekly pay
- Opportunity to join an established manufacturing team
 
Apply Now
If you're an experienced forklift operator looking for something beyond traditional warehouse work, we'd like to hear from you.

job.title: Carpenters & Experienced Hammerhands - Residential Construction
job.description:
EQUIP People is looking for one or two experienced Carpenters or Builders to join an architectural house build in Himatangi. We're looking for people who can hit the ground running, work accurately and take pride in producing quality work.

Qualified carpenters are the priority, particularly those confident with framing and detailed timber work. An experienced hammerhand with solid practical skills, common sense and the ability to work independently will also be considered.

There is an urgent need for people to get started as soon as possible, ideally tomorrow, with further residential and commercial construction projects coming up across the region.

What You'll Be Doing
- Internal wall framing and general carpentry
- Working on large timber gable ends
- Installing bamboo cladding
- Measuring, setting out and working accurately to instructions
- Assisting with general building and construction tasks
- Using hand and power tools safely
- Maintaining a tidy, organised and safe worksite
- Working alongside the builder to keep the project progressing
 
What We're Looking For
- Qualified carpenters/builders strongly preferred
- Proven residential construction or carpentry experience
- Confidence with framing, measuring and setting out
- Ability to follow instructions and work to a good standard
- Reliable, practical and safety-conscious
- Own tools and reliable transport preferred
- Able to work independently without constant supervision
 
Experienced hammerhands are also encouraged to apply if you have strong practical building skills, can confidently use tools and are ready to get stuck in.
 
What's On Offer
- Competitive rates based on experience and ability
- Urgent start available
- Immediate work on an architectural residential build
- Further projects expected across the region
- Potential for ongoing work through to January and beyond
- Opportunity to work directly alongside an experienced Licensed Building Practitioner
 
Apply Now
If you're an experienced carpenter, builder or capable hammerhand available to start immediately, we'd like to hear from you.
 
Please send through your current CV to apply@equippeople.co.nz or get in touch to discuss your experience and availability.

job.title: STMS Cat A & B
job.description:
EQUIP People is looking for experienced STMS Cat A and Cat B professionals to join our pool of traffic management workers across the Wellington region.
 
We work with established civil, infrastructure and traffic management contractors, with opportunities ranging from ongoing assignments through to longer-term projects.
 
Although these positions are offered on a casual employment agreement, we're looking for people who want consistent hours and reliable ongoing work.
 
What You'll Be Doing
- Depending on the site and level of responsibility, you may be involved in:
- Setting up, maintaining and packing down traffic management sites
- Implementing and managing Temporary Traffic Management Plans (TTMPs)
- Supervising TTM crews where required
- Carrying out site inspections and hazard assessments
- Ensuring traffic management requirements are followed
- Liaising with site managers, clients and the public
- Completing relevant traffic management documentation
- Maintaining a strong focus on site safety and compliance
 
What We're Looking For
- Current STMS Cat A or Cat B qualification
- Full Class 1 NZ Driver Licence
- Good understanding of temporary traffic management practices
- Reliable and safety-focused approach
- Strong communication skills
- Reliable transport
- Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screen
 
Highly Regarded
- Class 2 licence and experienced manual driving
- TMO qualification
- Civil construction experience
- First Aid Certificate
- Experience managing more complex traffic management sites
 
What's On Offer
- $28-$32 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications
- Casual employment agreement with regular full-time hours
- Weekly pay
- PPE provided
- Ongoing infrastructure and roading projects
- Potential for longer-term assignments
- Opportunities across the Wellington region
 
Apply Now
If you're an experienced STMS looking for consistent work and your next opportunity, we'd like to hear from you.
